end.summary:
Practised drawing square and triangular numbers with dot pictures.
Used rows to find triangular-number totals and extend a sequence.
Found new dots between 3×3 and 4×4 squares as 7.
Used overlapping rows and columns to correct 20 dots to 19.
Explained some picture patterns, but the visual argument for why the pattern is true was incomplete.
end.parentNote: Ishita practised representing square and triangular numbers with dot pictures and showing how a pattern grows. They used rows and columns to find totals and corrected the overlap error in the 20-dot example to 19 dots. At home, ask them to draw two matching triangular arrangements to make a rectangle and explain why the triangle is half of it.
